title: ADOPT the Resolutions of Necessity authorizing the commencement of eminent domain actions to acquire the Property Interests for the properties identified in…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0683, Resolution]
ADOPT the Resolutions of Necessity authorizing the commencement of eminent domain actions to acquire the Property Interests for the properties identified in Attachment A and described as follows:

1.	2900 Fernwood Avenue, Lynwood, CA 90262; APN: 6169-002-013; CPN: 86909 (Permanent Aerial Easement, 618 square feet; Permanent Utility Easement, 783 square feet; and a 24-month Temporary Construction Easement, 4,505 square feet)

2.	2800 Fernwood Avenue, Lynwood, CA 90262; APN: 6169-002-012; CPN: 86910 (Permanent Aerial Easement, 524 square feet; Permanent Utility Easement, 607 square feet; and a 24-month Temporary Construction Easement, 4,715 square feet)

The interests being acquired in the above-listed properties are referred to herein as the “Property Interests.”

(REQUIRES TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE FULL BOARD)
summary: Metro's board would adopt resolutions to begin eminent domain proceedings to take permanent aerial and utility easements and 24-month temporary construction easements on two properties on Fernwood Avenue in Lynwood.

details.action: resolution of necessity for eminent domain
